Hints: The same as 912 - 546; 10 tens = 1 hundred. 10 ones = 1 ten; regrouping 1 from hundreds to tens, and from tens to ones
Solution: The missing part is 912-546. Regroup 912 as 800+100+12. Subtract 500+40+6: 300+60+6 = 366. Check: 366+546 = 912.
